sentences.en: You do not want to incur the wrath of God.
sentences.zh: 你不想招致上帝的愤怒。

sentences.en: If you are not careful, you will incur prohibitive expenses.
sentences.zh: 如果不小心，你会遭受巨额开支。

sentences.en: Delaying study incurs the risk of great effort with little success.
sentences.zh: 拖延学习会招致付出巨大努力却成效甚微的风险。

senses.zh: 招致，引起（不愉快的事）；承担（责任、债务等）
